title: bigraded-diamond
description: The first math structure below settling: the settled section's underlying Heyting algebra closed under its two commuting nuclei (knowledge and truth), generating at each grade a nuclear quartet and, stacked by the (truth, knowledge) Klein-four, the post-settling diamond tower on which the richer fiber algebras are built.

heytingAlgebra.description: the free carrier A: the settled section's underlying Heyting algebra, on which both closures act

knowledgeNucleus.description: the knowledge closure j_k on A: a nucleus along the bilattice's knowledge order

truthNucleus.description: the truth closure j_t on A: a nucleus along the bilattice's truth order

nucleiCommute.description: j_k . j_t = j_t . j_k, so the composite is again a nucleus and the two paths A -> A* agree, making the four sub-algebras a commuting square rather than a single fixed point

nuclearQuartet.description: the diamond at each grade: the four canonical fixed-point sub-algebras (A, Fix(j_k), Fix(j_t), A* = Fix(j_k) cap Fix(j_t))

grading.description: the (truth, knowledge) Klein-four grading that stacks the nuclear quartets into the diamond tower as the closures are applied at successive grades
